component.name: Gnomos
component.summary: Control Sonos speakers, including first-generation hardware

description.p: Gnomos is a GTK4/libadwaita client for Sonos speakers, built on top of libnoson. It targets first-generation Sonos hardware (ZP80, ZP90, ZP100, ZP120, CR100) that Sonos's own current apps no longer support.
Volume/mute keyboard shortcuts, a "jump to current track" queue button, artist search from track details, and a fully collapsible Now Playing panel.
Confirmation dialogs, Settings and keyboard shortcuts rebuilt on current libadwaita widgets; the room sidebar now collapses on narrow windows; clipboard copy in the track details dialog.
Play history tab, light/dark appearance override, library entry counts, and a Space bar shortcut for play/pause.
Album/Artist cover art grid and a configurable, disk-persisted cover art cache.
Three-pane layout with a dedicated Now Playing panel, and cover art thumbnails throughout.
Fixed the "Gen 1" badge, which never appeared due to reading the wrong device property.
Add-to-queue and play-next actions, richer alarm options, destructive-action confirmations, local library search.
Fixed a false "queue could not be loaded" error and stale rows after clearing the queue.
Fixed duplicate service entries after relinking, and "remember last room" restoring the wrong room.
Support for third-party music services (Spotify, bonob and other SMAPI-based services).
Track details dialog, seek bar, queue reordering, save queue as playlist.
MPRIS2 support, sound settings, sleep timer, line-in switching.
Initial version: zone discovery, playback controls, volume, queue, favorites, alarms.
